title: sandbox.db.import — stream an instance container's logical dump (unencrypted, the tool db.backup uses: postgres pg_dump -Fc, mysql/mariadb SQL) into the sandbox at path through runsc exec; never written to the host disk. Errors: `sandbox <id> not found`. Feature sandbox.v2

id.description: the sandbox's id (lower-case ULID); runsc container falak-sbx-<id>

instance.description: the database instance's id; container falak-db-<instance>, on the sandbox's server

path.description: inside the sandbox: /workspace/db/<database>.dump (postgres) or .sql (mysql, mariadb); parent directories are created
